title: S070 Appendix E. TCP Options that May Be Used with BGP
parent_path: S070 Appendix E. TCP Options that May Be Used with BGP

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If a local system TCP user interface supports the TCP PUSH function, then each BGP message SHOULD be transmitted with PUSH flag set.
actions: Set PUSH flag on each outgoing BGP message

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If a local system TCP user interface supports setting the DSCP field [RFC2474] for TCP connections, then the TCP connection used by BGP SHOULD be opened with bits 0-2 of the DSCP field set to 110 (binary).
actions: Open TCP connection with DSCP field bits 0-2 set to 110 (binary)

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: An implementation MUST support the TCP MD5 option [RFC2385].
